summary: Ezekiel is called to take the word of the Lord to Israel—He sees a book in which lamentations and mourning are written.
meta_description: Ezekiel is called to take the word of the Lord to Israel—He sees a book in which lamentations and mourning are written.

footnotes.note1_a: The expression “son of man” used in Ezekiel refers only to this prophet. As a Hebrew idiom it means simply “human.” It is not to be confused with the title “Son of Man,” which refers to Christ.
